affected_files: class2-lane-cost69h-raw-batch1-20261115.jsonl (modified +8 -8, node totals drifted from the sweep audit by +611,900: 11,645,338 vs audit 11,033,438; same legal bit set [0,1,2,3,4,6,7,8], all loss=false, so no verdict conflict, but the node lines are not the audit-source run)

class2-lane-cost69h-raw-batch2-20261115.jsonl (modified +8 -8, bit set [9,10,14,17,19,20,21,22] contains 4 non-legal bits 17/19/20/21 per the X4 machine check of the second independent verification, and misses the 4 legal bits 12,15,18,23; the bit-21 loss=true line is an inert engine entry, X5-verified unable to collide with any legal root canon)
defect.detection_history: the 2026-11-16 theorem-applicability scan second independent verification (7c99621f) detected the batch2 bit-set mismatch and the missing batch3 (X6: 186 ok / 1 mismatched / 1 missing) but its X6 compares raw/audit candidate bit sets, which are identical for batch1, so the batch1 node drift was not detected there; this repair session found the batch1 drift by summing raw nodes against the audit batch aggregates

repair.method: byte-exact restoration from git history at the original publication commits, NOT a re-run
repair.fetched_via: two independent byte paths (raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned commits and the GitHub contents API resource) compared identical; post-push verification is pinned-commit raw + git blob sha recomputation

independent_verification.method: fresh full re-run of all 24 restored bits with the pinned engine class4_child1_runner_v16.ts (main blob aca15c2c local md5 match), node --experimental-strip-types, depth 10, cap 1000000000, andclose 1, child 0000000000000080120a000000200000, per-batch pilot d6 control 3402 nodes PASS x3

node_exact_vs_restored.batch2: 9/9 lines identical on the same key
node_exact_vs_restored.batch3: 9/9 lines identical on the same key

impact_on_downstream.verdicts: none: every restored bit is REFUTED-D10 (loss=false, not capped), matching both the clobbered batch1 verdicts and the audit; the WIN7-D10 bits 58/96 live in batches 5/7 which the race commit did not touch; the second verification X5 already machine-checked that the 4 inert non-legal engine entries cannot collide with any legal root canon, and the scan engine map verdicts are unchanged by the restoration
impact_on_downstream.fold_and_head: none: the cost-69h fold used the audit aggregate and the WIN receipts, both unaffected; canonical head bookkeeping unchanged
impact_on_downstream.scan_erratum: the second-verification data_quality_observations.cost_69h_publication_gap remains historically accurate for its pinned input state (post-race main); after this repair the raw batch2 bit set matches the audit plan and raw batch3 is present again
